metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with Wide-Spaced Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered monochrome square portrait framed by generous white margins and two levels of wide-tracked serif typography.
triggerTerms: classic album cover layout with white borders
formal black and white photography with centered text
excludeWhen: asymmetrical or chaotic layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white photograph of a man in formal attire (hat, bowtie, sunglasses) centered within a square frame, surrounded by a thick white border. The top margin contains two lines of text: a large, widely spaced serif name and a smaller, even more widely spaced subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Centered square image within a larger white square canvas
Hierarchical text placement in the top white margin
High contrast between the dark subject and the stark white background
coreInvariants: Monochrome color profile for the central image
Extremely wide tracking (letter spacing) in typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-close-up portrait centered horizontally and vertically within the inner square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, high-contrast portrait acts as the primary anchor, contrasted against the white negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the subtitle, and settles on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial white margins surround the central image, providing a clean, formal frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and grays within the photographic portrait
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for the primary display text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the white border and the dark subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high contrast and sharp terminals
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for vertical stems
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A high-contrast serif for the name paired with a minimalist, widely tracked secondary line for texture.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast serifs provide the necessary classical elegance.
Small serifs and wide proportions work well for the subtitle tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white square portrait of a man in a fedora and tuxedo, centered on a large white square canvas with thick margins.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered uppercase text in the top white margin. The top line should be a large serif font with wide tracking. The second line should be smaller with extreme tracking, spanning the width of the inner image.

verificationChecks: Is the color profile strictly monochrome?
Is the tracking on the text wide enough to feel airy?
Is the white border uniform on the sides and bottom?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Professional studio lighting in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black and white values
Ensure text is not touching the image frame
Confirm square aspect ratio for the inner image
recipe.reuseFormula: Square monochrome portrait + thick white border + wide-tracked uppercase serif typography in top margin.
